# acli-py issue

Work with issues (Jira's work items).


## `acli-py issue view`

Show an issue: its details, description, subtasks, links and latest comments.

--json prints the issue with plain names (status, assignee, links, comments…),
Markdown text and ISO dates; fields asked for with --fields are under "fields".

```text
acli-py issue view KEY [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py issue view DEMO-12
acli-py issue view DEMO-12 --fields customfield_10016 -c 10
acli-py issue view DEMO-12 --json | jq -r .status.name
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | required | Issue key, e.g. DEMO-12. |
| `--fields` `TEXT` |  | Extra fields to show, comma-separated ('*all' for everything). |
| `-c`, `--comments` `INTEGER` | `3` | How many recent comments to show. |
| `-w`, `--web` |  | Open it in the browser instead. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `acli-py issue search`

Find issues with a smart query, JQL, and/or simple options.

```text
acli-py issue search [JQL] [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py issue search '@me is:open #web sort:-priority'
acli-py issue search 'p:DEMO s:progress updated:7d "login"'
acli-py issue search -p DEMO -a @me --open
acli-py issue search 'project = DEMO AND sprint in openSprints()' --csv
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `JQL` |  | A smart query ('@me #web is:open', see --syntax) or JQL (optional). |
| `-p`, `--project` `TEXT` |  | Project key (default: `acli-py config set project`). |
| `-a`, `--assignee` `TEXT` |  | @me, 'none', email or name. |
| `-s`, `--status` `TEXT` |  | Status name (repeatable). |
| `-t`, `--type` `TEXT` |  | Issue type (repeatable). |
| `-L`, `--label` `TEXT` |  | Label (repeatable). |
| `-T`, `--text` `TEXT` |  | Full-text search. |
| `-o`, `--open` |  | Only issues not done yet. |
| `--filter` `TEXT` |  | Use a saved filter's JQL (by id). |
| `--order` `TEXT` |  | Sort field; prefix '-' for descending, e.g. -created. |
| `--fields` `TEXT` |  | Columns to show, comma-separated field ids. |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--count` |  | Only print how many match. |
| `-w`, `--web` |  | Open it in the browser instead. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
| `--syntax` |  | Show the smart query syntax and exit. |
| `--raw` |  | Send the query as JQL, never as a smart query. |


## `acli-py issue create`

Create an issue, or many from a JSON/CSV file.

Options given on the command line fill in what each file row leaves out.

```text
acli-py issue create [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py issue create -p DEMO -t Bug -s "Login fails on Safari" -a @me -L web
acli-py issue create --from-csv backlog.csv -p DEMO --dry-run
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-p`, `--project` `TEXT` |  | Project key (default: `acli-py config set project`). |
| `-t`, `--type` `TEXT` |  | Issue type: Task, Bug, Story, Epic… |
| `-s`, `--summary` `TEXT` |  | One-line title. |
| `-d`, `--description` `TEXT` |  | Markdown (or ADF JSON). '-' reads standard input. |
| `-D`, `--description-file` `PATH` |  | Read the description from a file. |
| `-a`, `--assignee` `TEXT` |  | Email, account id, name, @me, 'default' or 'none'. |
| `--reporter` `TEXT` |  | Email, account id, name or @me. |
| `-P`, `--priority` `TEXT` |  | Priority name. |
| `-L`, `--label` `TEXT` |  | Label (repeat, or comma-separate). |
| `-C`, `--component` `TEXT` |  | Component name (repeatable). |
| `--fix-version` `TEXT` |  | Fix version name (repeatable). |
| `--parent` `TEXT` |  | Parent issue key (epic, story). |
| `--due` `TEXT` |  | Due date, YYYY-MM-DD ('' clears). |
| `-F`, `--field` `TEXT` |  | Any field: 'Story Points=5', 'Team=Blue', or raw JSON with 'NAME:=JSON'. |
| `-e`, `--editor` |  | Write the summary and description in $EDITOR. |
| `--from-json` `PATH` |  | Create from a JSON file: one issue or a list. |
| `--from-csv` `PATH` |  | Create one issue per row of a CSV file with a header. |
| `-f`, `--from-file` `PATH` |  | Read the summary (first line) and description (the rest) from a text file. |
| `--template` |  | Print an example --from-json file and exit. |
| `--open` |  | Open the new issue in the browser. |
| `--ignore-errors` |  | Keep going when one item fails; exit 1 at the end. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


## `acli-py issue edit`

Change fields on one or many issues.

```text
acli-py issue edit [KEYS] [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py issue edit DEMO-4 -s "New title" --add-label urgent
acli-py issue edit --jql 'project = DEMO AND labels = old' --remove-label old -y
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEYS` |  | Issue keys (DEMO-1 DEMO-2, or DEMO-1,DEMO-2). |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues this JQL finds. |
| `--filter` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues of this saved filter id. |
| `-f`, `--from-file` `PATH` |  | Read issue keys from a file (commas, spaces or lines; '-' for stdin). |
| `-s`, `--summary` `TEXT` |  | One-line title. |
| `-d`, `--description` `TEXT` |  | Markdown (or ADF JSON). '-' reads standard input. |
| `-D`, `--description-file` `PATH` |  | Read the description from a file. |
| `-t`, `--type` `TEXT` |  | Issue type: Task, Bug, Story, Epic… |
| `-a`, `--assignee` `TEXT` |  | Email, account id, name, @me, 'default' or 'none'. |
| `--reporter` `TEXT` |  | Email, account id, name or @me. |
| `-P`, `--priority` `TEXT` |  | Priority name. |
| `-L`, `--label` `TEXT` |  | Replace all labels with these. |
| `--add-label` `TEXT` |  | Add labels, keeping the others. |
| `--remove-label` `TEXT` |  | Remove these labels. |
| `-C`, `--component` `TEXT` |  | Component name (repeatable). |
| `--fix-version` `TEXT` |  | Fix version name (repeatable). |
| `--parent` `TEXT` |  | Parent issue key (epic, story). |
| `--due` `TEXT` |  | Due date, YYYY-MM-DD ('' clears). |
| `-F`, `--field` `TEXT` |  | Any field: 'Story Points=5', 'Team=Blue', or raw JSON with 'NAME:=JSON'. |
| `-e`, `--editor` |  | Edit the summary and description in $EDITOR. |
| `--from-json` `PATH` |  | Apply a Jira edit payload ({fields, update}) file. |
| `--notify`, `--no-notify` | `True` | Email watchers about the change. |
| `--template` |  | Print an example --from-json file and exit. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--ignore-errors` |  | Keep going when one item fails; exit 1 at the end. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |

## `acli-py issue clone`

Copy issues (summary, description, type, priority, labels…), in place or to a project.

With --to-site, copies go to another site you are logged in to, each with a web
link back to its original.

```text
acli-py issue clone [KEYS] [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py issue clone DEMO-1 DEMO-2 --prefix " "
acli-py issue clone --jql 'sprint = 7' --to-project OPS
acli-py issue clone DEMO-1 --to-site me@other.atlassian.net --to-project NEW
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEYS` |  | Issue keys (DEMO-1 DEMO-2, or DEMO-1,DEMO-2). |
| `-p`, `--to-project` `TEXT` |  | Clone into this project (default: same one). |
| `--prefix` `TEXT` |  | Put this before each copied summary. |
| `--link`, `--no-link` | `True` | Link each copy to its original. |
| `--to-site` `TEXT` |  | Clone into another saved account's site (email@site or the site); needs --to-project. |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues this JQL finds. |
| `--filter` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues of this saved filter id. |
| `-f`, `--from-file` `PATH` |  | Read issue keys from a file (commas, spaces or lines; '-' for stdin). |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--ignore-errors` |  | Keep going when one item fails; exit 1 at the end. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |

## `acli-py issue comment`

Read, add, edit and delete comments.


### `acli-py issue comment list`

Show an issue's comments, oldest first.

```text

```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | required | Issue key, e.g. DEMO-12. |
| `--newest-first` |  | Show the latest comment first. |
| `-l`, `--limit` `INTEGER` | `50` | Show at most this many results. |
| `-A`, `--all` |  | Fetch every page, ignoring --limit. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |


### `acli-py issue comment add`

Comment on one or many issues.

```text
acli-py issue comment add [KEYS] [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py issue comment add DEMO-3 -b "Fixed in **2.4**"
echo "Deployed" | acli-py issue comment add --jql 'fixVersion = 2.4' -b - -y
```

|---|---|---|
| `KEYS` |  | Issue keys (DEMO-1 DEMO-2, or DEMO-1,DEMO-2). |
| `-b`, `--body` `TEXT` |  | Markdown (or ADF JSON); '-' reads stdin. |
| `-B`, `--body-adf`, `--body-file` `PATH` |  | Read the body from a file: Markdown, or ADF JSON ('-' for stdin). |
| `-e`, `--editor` |  | Write the body in $EDITOR. |
| `--role` `TEXT` |  | Only this project role can see it. |
| `--group` `TEXT` |  | Only this group can see it. |
| `--edit-last` |  | Replace your latest comment instead. |
| `-q`, `--jql` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues this JQL finds. |
| `--filter` `TEXT` |  | Act on the issues of this saved filter id. |
| `-f`, `--from-file` `PATH` |  | Read issue keys from a file (commas, spaces or lines; '-' for stdin). |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--ignore-errors` |  | Keep going when one item fails; exit 1 at the end. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |

## `acli-py issue link`

Link issues to each other.


### `acli-py issue link add`

Link two issues, read as a sentence.

```text
acli-py issue link add [SOURCE] [KIND] [TARGET] [OPTIONS]
```

```sh
acli-py issue link add DEMO-1 blocks DEMO-2
acli-py issue link add DEMO-5 "is duplicated by" DEMO-9
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE` |  | The issue the sentence starts with. |
| `KIND` |  | Link type or phrase: blocks, 'is blocked by', relates to, Duplicate… |
| `TARGET` |  | The other issue. |
| `--from-json` `PATH` |  | Many links: [{"from": "A-1", "type": "blocks", "to": "A-2"}]. |
| `--from-csv` `PATH` |  | Many links: CSV with from,type,to columns. |
| `-m`, `--comment` `TEXT` |  | Also comment on the first issue. |
| `--template` |  | Print an example --from-json file and exit. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `--ignore-errors` |  | Keep going when one item fails; exit 1 at the end. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |


### `acli-py issue link list`

|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | required | Issue key, e.g. DEMO-12. |

### `acli-py issue link delete`

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `KEY` | required | Issue key, e.g. DEMO-12. |
| `WORKLOG_IDS` | required | Worklog ids. |
| `-y`, `--yes` |  | Don't ask for confirmation. |
| `-n`, `--dry-run` |  | Show what would change without changing anything. Reads still run. |
